features: Bypasses the legacy SELECT * competitor-copy path in Scoring Tests
Generate Competitors now uses TestCompetitorGeneratorService before the legacy dashboard controller executes
Copies only stable BDC identity and scoring fields required by test scoring
Competitor photo fields including original_photo_url are not read or written by test generation
Normal BDC tier selection continues through the shared ScoringRulesService
No official points, progression, publications or production scoring data is modified
No Staging or Production deployment performed
